changelog.en:
New: full-screen wallpaper preview with a bottom-sheet settings drawer (wallpaper name in the toolbar, weather button and overflow menu matching the main settings page, translucent sheet)
New: revamped wallpaper cards on the home screen, banner carousel, polished About page
New: tap interaction on the Grass wallpaper (release a dandelion seed or firefly at the tap point); the preview now supports tap interaction for Fireworks, Nexus and NixieTube

Fixed: wallpaper settings now take effect immediately without restarting the app or re-selecting the wallpaper, Grass stars/dandelions/fireflies fade smoothly with day and night, seekbar card margins aligned with regular cards

Changed: 'open system preview' button renamed to 'set as wallpaper' across 13 languages, removed the obsolete preview-ratio menu option
changelog.zh:
新增：全屏壁纸预览 + 底部抽屉设置（工具栏显示壁纸名，天气按钮与溢出菜单与主设置页一致，抽屉半透明）
新增：主设置页壁纸卡片改版、首页横幅轮播、关于页修改
新增：草地壁纸点击交互（点击放出一粒蒲公英/萤火虫）；烟火、交错光幕、辉光管预览支持点击

修复：壁纸设置修改后立即生效（无需重启程序或重选壁纸）、草地壁纸星星/蒲公英/萤火虫随日夜平滑渐变、SeekBar 卡片边距统一

变更：按钮文案“打开系统预览”改为“设置壁纸”（13 种语言）、移除“预览比例”菜单项
